_comment: Crew roles for Mission Ares 1. 'modifiers' are multipliers the gameplay scene can read from GameState.role_data (1.0 = normal). 'color' tints the placeholder astronaut sprite.

engineer.title: ENGINEER
perks: Solar panels and batteries lose less Energy
engineer.fact: Real Mars bases would run on solar panels, batteries and maybe small nuclear reactors.

biologist.title: BIOLOGIST
biologist.fact: Plants turn carbon dioxide into oxygen. Astronauts have grown lettuce on the ISS!

medic.title: MEDIC
perks: Keeps the sleeping crew's pods safe
medic.fact: Astronauts lose bone and muscle in low gravity, so they exercise about 2 hours every day.

astrophysicist.title: ASTROPHYSICIST
astrophysicist.tagline: Reads the sky and the Sun.
perks: Gets warnings before solar storms hit
astrophysicist.fact: NASA watches the Sun every day to warn astronauts about dangerous solar storms.
